why: Searches for proofs, 2025 arXiv work, and the problem's own Wikipedia article all describe the problem as still open and tied to non-abelian class field theory / the Langlands program, with no claimed resolution or incremental result on the stated reciprocity law since January 2024; a June 2026 Simons Foundation survey of Hilbert's 23 problems reiterates it as unsolved rather than reporting progress.
